label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

findings.problem: The first Tab stop is a Chat button inside an embedded frame, before the Skip To Content link; the chat widget gets focus before any page content.
Skip To Content link does nothing useful: after pressing Enter and Tab, focus lands on the first menu link again instead of the main content, so the header cannot be bypassed.

Main menu links open a large mega menu on Enter but the menu items cannot be reached right after; Tab jumps to the next top-level item and the submenu links only come after the whole header, so I could not tell where the menu was.
Reaching the options needed about 40 Tab presses: the full header, an image carousel, several unnamed links, and each of the 24 colour swatches is its own Tab stop, with no way to jump past them.

After pressing Add to bag, keyboard focus was reset to the top of the page, the cart count still read 0 and no message or cart panel told me whether the item was added, so I could not confirm the add or find the way to checkout.
